author: Zhu Jianqiu / 朱剑秋
scope: Separate optional import collection. Not registered as a preloaded/classical game pack. All delivered main lines begin at the normal starting position.
completenessScope: Source-reported final recorded moves/resignation/end statements, with two separately recovered full records. Legal replay alone is not treated as proof of completeness.
displayMetadata: Round values Book game N identify the original collection chapter, not tournament rounds. Original sourceRound and sourceEvent values are retained. Where the source event was only the Chinese book title, its display Event is the English collection title.
timeControl: Unknown for every delivered game. No classical clock inferred.

recoveredFullGames.completeness: The public full-game main line starts from the standard board and ends in actual checkmate.
recoveredFullGames.metadataNote: Date1960-12 is retained from the collection record; independent viewer has no structureddate field. Do not invent a day or round.

recoveredFullGames.match: Exact canonical board and side to move, followed by exact full excerpt suffix. Converted Chinese mainline with unique legal moves.
recoveredFullGames.dateConflict: Newspaper game column says 1988-09-15; a public Dpxq catalog says 1988-09-12; original book month retained.
recoveredFullGames.completion: Source ends 44.Red with Red wins, no further-moves omission statement.

sourceMoveCorrections.description: Source main line reverses its third and fourth half-moves; independent full-game record corroborates swapping only those two plies.
sourceMoveCorrections.metadataConflict: Collection source labels 1988 individual final, independent source labels 1988 team championship. Original metadata retained; event not resolved.
